messages.subject: Reminder: Corporate know-how session - Anti-dilution mechanics
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

A reminder that this month's corporate know-how session, 'Anti-dilution mechanics in venture deals: weighted-average vs full ratchet', takes place Thursday at 12:30 in Room 4B (lunch provided). 1 hour CPD. Please register via the L&D portal.

Learning & Development, Whitfield Carter LLP
